SELECT b.id, b.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_code AS warehouseCode, w.name AS warehouseName, b.sku_id AS skuId, k.sku_code AS skuCode, k.spec_name AS skuName, p.name AS productName, b.lot_id AS lotId, t.lot_no AS lotNo, t.source_lot_no AS sourceLotNo, b.unit, b.quantity, b.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM xsy_inventory_lot_balance b LEFT JOIN xsy_warehouse w ON w.id = b.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN xsy_product_sku k ON k.id = b.sku_id LEFT JOIN xsy_product_spu p ON p.id = k.spu_id LEFT JOIN xsy_trace_lot t ON t.id = b.lot_id WHERE b.quantity > 0 AND FALSE
AND b.warehouse_id IN #{scopeId}
AND b.warehouse_id = #{query.warehouseId} AND b.sku_id = #{query.skuId}
AND t.lot_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.lotNo}, '%')
AND t.source_lot_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.sourceLotNo}, '%')
AND p.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.productName}, '%')
ORDER BY b.warehouse_id, b.sku_id, b.lot_id
